sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PLD 2023 Punjab Statutes 53
PLD 2023 Punjab Statutes 53
ACT X OF 2023
PUNJAB WILDLIFE (PROTECTION, PRESERVATION,
CONSERVATION AND MANAGEMENT) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2023
An Act to amend the Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation,
Conservation and Management) Act, 1974
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary, 17th February, 2023]
No. PAP/Legis-2(132)/2021/103, dated 17.2.2023.---The Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation,
Conservation and Management) (Amendment) Bill 2021, having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on the 9th day of January 2023, and assented
to by the Governor of the Punjab on the 23rd day of January 2023, is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
It is necessary to amend the Punjab Wildlife
(Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Act, 1974 (II of 1974)
for the purposes hereinafter appearing.
Be it enacted
by Provincial Assembly
of the Punjab as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be cited as the Punjab Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation
and Management) (Amendment) Act, 2023.
(2) This Act
shall come into force at once.
